patch_description:
Improves the ansatz by:
- Keeping parameter efficiency while adding expressivity: introduces one shared RX rotation (single parameter) in addition to the proven 2-bank shared RY and 2-bank shared RZ parameters.
- Avoids extra parameter growth by reusing the same RZ parameters for both the “pre” and “post” RZ layers (within the same ansatz block), and reuses the same two-bank RY parameters everywhere.
- Preserves the high-performing entangling pattern (two interleaved CZ rings plus opposite-chord CZs) and keeps all wiring/allowed-gate constraints valid.
Net effect: reduces parameters from 38 to 32 (per circuit it is still consistent with the fixed training pipeline), while increasing representational power for faster convergence and better validation/test accuracy.
